exposure: cold gel pad application to the perineum
outcome: ability to perform daily activities (lying down, sitting, walking, infant care, breastfeeding, urination)
cohort: 200 mothers who had a vaginal delivery, including both primiparous and multiparous women.
finding: Application of cold gel pads to the perineum significantly relieved perineal pain and increased postpartum comfort in women after vaginal delivery, improving their ability to perform daily activities.
followup_time: within the first few hours postpartum (assessments were made in the postpartum first 2 hours and 4 hours after the first application)
